params.note: one silent corruption (quantity + 1) per trial on a dense 10-level book, heartbeats never stop; for the checksum policy undetected_wrong_updates counts the one wrong update before the mismatch is seen and resubscribe repairs the book; for heartbeat_only it counts every message after which the local book differs from truth. A heartbeat-only recorder never resubscribes here by construction; this measures the policy mechanism, not any venue's behaviour.

data_sources.url: in-process seeded synthetic stream (no external data)
